title: Source-Bound Same-Endpoint Temporal Refinement Seam Audit

source_findings.transaction_temporal_callback_shape: transaction_model_t.temporal_error receives exactly full_state and half_state final states and returns one scalar
source_findings.transaction_existing_trial_topology: execute_reference_interval constructs one full route and one two-half route from the same attempt checkpoint
source_findings.transaction_existing_retry_semantics: a rejection multiplies attempt_dt by retry_scale, so the next retry ends at an earlier attempt endpoint
source_findings.transaction_existing_accept_route: the accepted physical state is the two-half state of the accepted attempt

interpretation.reason_test_only: A nonproduction harness can clone the same source state and execute 1, 2, 4 or more equal substeps to the same endpoint for scientific characterization.
interpretation.reason_not_composable: The current generic transaction API has no contract for a refinement hierarchy, per-level mass and cost diagnostics, selection of a refined trajectory, or fail-closed refinement exhaustion while retaining one outer endpoint.

smallest_required_F_KT_capability.purpose: Permit bounded same-endpoint refinement without weakening checkpoint, rollback, mass or generic-time semantics.
requirements: one immutable attempt origin for every compared refinement level
all compared levels terminate at the same attempt t1
generic level progression independent of model-specific observable definition
model-owned scalar comparison hook or equivalent owner-qualified observation seam
hard mass acceptance for every trajectory eligible for publication
only one selected refined trajectory may become the transaction candidate
rejected or superseded trajectories never mutate committed state
explicit bounded maximum refinement level or cost budget
diagnostics for levels executed, solver work, mass residual, rejection class and selected level
retry endpoint shortening, if retained, remains a separate fallback action after same-endpoint evaluation and is not itself counted as convergence evidence

architecture_invariant_check.7_transactional_steps: preserved only if all levels share immutable origin and only selected level can publish
architecture_invariant_check.8_recompute_and_warm_start: compatible; warm starts may be numerical only and physical origin remains exact
architecture_invariant_check.9_generic_time: same-endpoint hierarchy is defined over generic [t0,t1]
architecture_invariant_check.13_mass_conservation: remains hard for each publishable trajectory
architecture_invariant_check.15_coupling_cost: requires bounded conditional refinement, not unconditional deep hierarchy
architecture_invariant_check.23_physics_solver_policy_separation: preserved; refinement is numerical policy and cannot change physics
architecture_invariant_check.24_bounded_cost: requires explicit level or work cap and diagnosed fallback
architecture_invariant_check.25_reference_mode: must retain a stricter reference profile
architecture_invariant_check.29_no_silent_dependencies: no calendar, file or MODFLOW assumptions introduced
architecture_invariant_check.30_architecture_change_gate: F-KT owner qualification required before production transaction change

next_action: Open a separate F-KT owner-resolution workunit for the smallest generic same-endpoint nested-refinement transaction seam. F-SI21 may continue nonproduction numerical characterization in parallel only if it is explicitly labelled algorithmic evidence and is not treated as proof of production transaction admissibility.
